blacklistabilityReview.evidence: D28 scoped review at Ethereum block 26097118 on 2026-10-01: the GUSD proxy and balance store both point to implementation 0x6704ba24b8640bccee6bf2fd276a6a1b8edf4ade and custodian 0xb983ed57aeaa180bc7a0078ddadf1ea217f2e421. Current direct power: sweeper 0xd24400ae8bfebb18ca49be86258a3c749cf46853 can enable sweeping with holder signatures and replay it for previously delegated accounts; this is not demonstrated unilateral seizure of arbitrary holders. Immediately restorable permission: no separate revoked account-freeze role and regrant path was established by this review. Future-upgrade power: the current custodian can confirm replacement of proxy/store implementation through two distinct signer callbacks, with observed default/extended delays of 172800/604800 seconds. Replacement logic could change transfers or balances, so that adverse control exposure remains. The broad true verdict from the 2026-05-12 inferred review is retained conservatively; it must not be read as proof of an active arbitrary-account blacklist selector. Bridge escrow controls remain separately documented in bridgeRouteRisk.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: GUSD is issued by Gemini on Ethereum (verified mint-authority review 2026-07-15: limited-printer EOA plus 2-of-3 issuance/upgrade custodians).

Rainbow Bridge representation: the NEAR-side token 056fd409e1d7a124bd7017459dfea2f387b6d5cd.factory.bridge.near is issued by the Rainbow factory, with underlying GUSD locked in Ethereum ERC20Locker 0x23ddd3e3692d1861ed57ede224608875809e127f. At Ethereum block 26095801, admin() returned 0x2468603819bf09ed3fb6f3efeff24b1955f3cde1 and paused() returned 253. Verified source defines PAUSED_LOCK as 1 and PAUSED_UNLOCK as 2 and tests each flag separately; the raw mask is recorded without treating it as evidence of halted withdrawals. The admin can bypass pause flags and has adminTransfer, arbitrary storage-write and delegatecall capabilities. NEAR metadata at height 218027439 confirms GUSD with two decimals.
